role: declared formula with solution variables and parameter variables
notes: The semicolon separates the solution variables from the parameter variables; the listed variables are pairwise distinct and contain the free variables. Not a new connective.

role: solution set of a declared formula at a parameter tuple
notes: Subset of the n-th Cartesian power of the domain; depends on the declared variable list. Written \(\varphi(M^n)\) when there are no parameter variables. Distinct in scope and meaning from the P10 metalevel instantiation \(\varphi(M)\).

role: simultaneous update of an assignment on a list of distinct variables
notes: Equals the iterated single updates of the registered \(s[x\mapsto a]\) in any order.

role: coordinate map from M^n to M^k induced by a function from {1..k} to {1..n}
notes: Covers permutation, projection, identification and dummy coordinates; images and preimages of sets of tuples.

role: set of A-definable subsets of M^n
notes: A Boolean subalgebra of the power set of M^n; n at least 1.

role: diagonal set of n-tuples whose i-th and j-th entries agree
notes: Subset of M^n; empty indices impossible since 1<=i,j<=n.

role: automorphisms of a structure fixing a parameter set pointwise
notes: Extends the registered \(\operatorname{Aut}(\mathcal M)\) by the relative form over A; acts on tuples coordinatewise and on sets of tuples by images.

role: extension to an elementary extension of a set definable in the smaller structure
notes: Defined by the same formula and parameters evaluated in the larger structure; well defined by the theorem.

role: solution set of a formula relative to a declared variable list
notes: Annex-only notation in the proof of the least-family theorem; not the substitution brackets \(\varphi[t/x]\).

role: graph of a term relative to a declared variable list
notes: Annex-only notation in the proof of the least-family theorem; not the substitution brackets \(\varphi[t/x]\).
